# Config: Notifications

> **Reader:** `NotificationsConfig` (`config/NotificationsConfig.qml`)
> **Schema:** `config/json/config.schema.json` → `properties.Notifications` · category Notifications · scope personal

Notifications: Where notification toasts appear, how long they stay, and what the history keeps. Toasts sit inside the work area, the space the bars and screen border leave free, so a gap is measured from whatever is at that edge: a bar, the border's stroke, or the bare screen edge.

Each setting: `path` · type = default · enum/range/unit; then title: description; annotations; `read:` the reader member(s) (exact unless marked) and `in:` the files that use them.


### `Notifications.screen`

- **`Notifications.screen`** · object
  - Monitors: Where toasts appear. As in General follows General > Monitors; the primary monitor is the one set in General; the focused monitor is the one with your active workspace when the notification arrives; every monitor shows each toast on all of them, and closing one closes the rest.
- **`Notifications.screen.mode`** · string = "inherit" · enum inherit|primary|focused|all
  - Monitors
  - x-scope="look", x-link={"setting":"General.screen"}
  - read: `NotificationsConfig.screen` (whole) · in: `config/NotificationsConfig.qml`

### `Notifications`

- **`Notifications.position`** · string = "topLeft" · enum topLeft|topRight|bottomLeft|bottomRight
  - Corner: Corner of the work area the toasts stack from. Bottom corners stack upwards.
  - x-scope="look"
  - read: `NotificationsConfig.position` · in: `config/NotificationsConfig.qml`

### `Notifications.gaps`

- **`Notifications.gaps`** · object

### `Notifications`

- **`Notifications.timeout`** · integer = 5000 · 1000–60000 · s
  - Toast duration: How long a toast stays up. Hovering it pauses the countdown.
  - x-control="stepper", x-group="Toasts"
  - read: `NotificationsConfig.timeout` · in: `shell/Notifications.qml`
- **`Notifications.appTimeouts`** · boolean = true
  - Use app timeouts: When an app asks for its own duration, or for its notification to stay until dismissed, use that instead of the duration above.
  - x-group="Toasts"
  - read: `NotificationsConfig.appTimeouts` · in: `components/surfaces/notifications/NotificationToast.qml`
- **`Notifications.criticalStays`** · boolean = true
  - Critical toasts stay: Critical notifications stay up until you dismiss them.
  - x-group="Toasts"
  - read: `NotificationsConfig.criticalStays` · in: `components/surfaces/notifications/NotificationToast.qml`
- **`Notifications.maxToasts`** · integer = 5 · 1–10
  - Visible toasts: How many toasts stack up at once. A new one pushes out the oldest.
  - x-scope="look", x-control="stepper", x-group="Toasts"
  - read: `NotificationsConfig.maxToasts` · in: `shell/Notifications.qml`
- **`Notifications.width`** · integer = 360 · 240–600 · px
  - Toast width: Width of each toast.
  - x-scope="look", x-group="Toasts"
  - read: `NotificationsConfig.width` (computed) · in: `shell/Notifications.qml`
- **`Notifications.quietFullscreen`** · boolean = true
  - Quiet over fullscreen: Show no toasts on a monitor whose workspace has a fullscreen window. Critical ones still show, and everything still goes to the history.
  - x-group="Toasts"
  - read: `NotificationsConfig.quietFullscreen` · in: `shell/Notifications.qml`
- **`Notifications.clearOnFocus`** · boolean = false
  - Clear when the app is focused: Focusing an app's window removes its notifications from the history.
  - x-group="Notification history"
  - read: `NotificationsConfig.clearOnFocus` · in: `services/system/NotificationManager.qml`
- **`Notifications.removeOnClick`** · boolean = false
  - Remove when clicked: Clicking a notification, or one of its actions, removes it from the history.
  - x-group="Notification history"
  - read: `NotificationsConfig.removeOnClick` · in: `components/content/parts/notifications/NotificationItemDelegate.qml`, `components/surfaces/notifications/NotificationToast.qml`
- **`Notifications.closeRemoves`** · boolean = false
  - Closing a toast removes it: Closing a toast (its close button or a swipe) also removes the notification from the history. Off, it only hides the toast.
  - x-group="Notification history"
  - read: `NotificationsConfig.closeRemoves` · in: `components/surfaces/notifications/NotificationToast.qml`
- **`Notifications.maxEntries`** · integer = 100 · 10–500
  - History size: How many notifications the history keeps. The oldest go first.
  - x-group="Notification history"
  - read: `NotificationsConfig.maxEntries` · in: `services/system/NotificationManager.qml`
- **`Notifications.maxAge`** · integer = 0 · 0–31536000000 · d
  - Keep for: Remove notifications older than this many days. 0 keeps them until removed.
  - x-group="Notification history"
  - read: `NotificationsConfig.maxAge` · in: `services/system/NotificationManager.qml`
